race.title: BNG Made Easy With Reverte Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Cases can be made for a few of these, but the vote goes to PADDY DE POLE , who notched his fifth success over hurdles at Sedgefield a couple of months ago and Paul Nicholls' 8-y-o returns only 2 lb higher. He can enhance his fine record under Freddie Keighley at the expense of Jackstell , whose yard couldn't be in much better form. Oakley looks best of the rest. PADDY DE POLE (IRE) JACKSTELL (FR) OAKLEY (GER)
race.bettingForecast: Paddy De Pole (2/1), Jackstell (3/1), Oakley (7/2), Secret Trix (6/1), I'm A Starman (8/1), Jaytee (14/1)
